# Picsart gen-ai CLI, MCP & Skills

> Documentation for the Picsart CLI, hosted MCP, and application APIs. The SDK snapshot contains 238 models from 32 providers.

Catalogs can differ by release. Authenticate each interface separately and validate inputs before generating.

## Getting started
- [Introduction](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/introduction): choose an interface
- [Installation](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/installation): install the gen-ai CLI (npm or install script)
- [Authentication](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/authentication): CLI, hosted OAuth, and application credentials

## Interfaces
- [Integrations](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/integrations/): host setup and compatibility limitations
- [SDK](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/sdk): TypeScript applications
- [REST API](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/rest-api): HTTP workflow reference
- [CLI Quickstart](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/cli-quickstart): generate, batch, pipe, upload from the terminal
- [MCP Quickstart](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/mcp-quickstart): connect a supported agent using hosted MCP
- [Skills](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/skills): instructions for agents with working execution tools

## Picsart Media Studio (separate connector)
- [Media Studio](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/media-studio/): connect and compose existing assets
- [Media Studio tools](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/media-studio/tools): tool reference
- [Media Studio troubleshooting](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/media-studio/troubleshooting): connection and rendering problems

## Concepts
- [Local files](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/local-files): upload files and supply reachable input URLs
- [Media tools](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/media-tools): compose, inspect, validate, and render scenes
- [Security](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/security): credentials and asset access
- [Errors and rate limits](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/rate-limits): recovery without duplicate submissions
- [Generating media](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/generating): prompts, inputs, aspect ratio, duration, outputs
- [Files & Drive](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/files-and-drive): upload, download, and list files on Picsart Drive
- [Pricing & Credits](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/pricing): per-generation credit cost; estimate before running
- [Batch & Automation](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/batch): JSON manifests and directory processing

## Model reference
- [Model Reference overview](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/): all 238 models, how to read a provider page
- [Model Catalog](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/catalog): searchable, filterable catalog of every model
- [Image generation](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/image): 73 image models
- [Video generation](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/video): 96 video models
- [Audio generation](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/audio): 33 audio models
- [Structured JSON](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/json): 1 JSON models
- [Text and analysis](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/text): 35 text models

## Providers
Each provider page lists its models and parameters, with CLI and MCP examples where available. Parameters use the versioned SDK snapshot.
- [All providers](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/providers/): index of all 32 providers
- [Anthropic](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/providers/anthropic): 9 models: text
- [Async](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/providers/async): 1 model: audio
- [ByteDance](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/providers/bytedance): 22 models: image, video, audio
- [Creatify](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/providers/creatify): 2 models: video
